author: ojiudezue
title: v5.84.0 shipped: Fan-interference recheck deadlock fix — D2 defers to recheck so it can finally arm and vacate fan-ghosted rooms
summary: The fan-recheck had NEVER worked (5-day+ deadlock, live-confirmed): D2 mmwave-fan demotion set occupied=False before the recheck could arm on occupied=True. Fix: D2 defers demotion for recheck-eligible rooms via a side-effect-free is_recheck_eligible() OR-composed into D2's guard; sleep-veto scoped to bedrooms; per-room loop isolation. Tier 2-DB: 3 reviews all SHIP (deadlock-break proven, no inverse deadlock) + F-C-2 hollow-test fix. Behavioral proof = live-validation (real-coord in-suite = v5.8.0 territory).
